blocks.text: Yeh chapter 11 (Hydrocarbons) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Hydrocarbons are organic compounds that contain:
(Hydrocarbons aise organic compounds hain jin mein kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hydrocarbons organic compounds ki woh qisam hai jo sirf carbon aur hydrogen se bani hoti hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: Hydrocarbons is a class of organic compounds that consists of only carbon and hydrogen.

blocks.prompt:
2 Hydrocarbons are found in abundance in:
(Hydrocarbons kahan bohat ziyada miqdaar mein milte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Hydrocarbons petroleum aur natural gas mein bohat milte hain aur ghar aur industry mein fuel (eendhan) ke taur par istemal hote hain (11.1).

book_ref.quote: Hydrocarbons are abundantly found in petroleum and natural gas.

blocks.prompt:
3 Which hydrocarbons are especially used as the starting materials for a number of industrial products?
(Kaun se hydrocarbons khaas taur par bohat si industrial products ke liye starting materials (ibtidaai maddah) hain?)
blocks.explanation: Unsaturated hydrocarbons, khaas taur par alkenes, bohat si industrial products ka ibtidaai maddah hain (11.1).

book_ref.quote: Unsaturated hydrocarbons, especially alkenes, are used as the starting materials

blocks.prompt:
4 Aliphatic compounds can be:
(Aliphatic compounds kaise ho sakte hain?)

options.text: open chain ya cyclic, saturated ya unsaturated

blocks.explanation: Aliphatic compounds open chain ya cyclic (halqa-daar), aur saturated ya unsaturated ho sakte hain; yeh woh compounds hain jo aromatic nahi (11.1).

book_ref.quote: Aliphatic compounds may be open chain and cyclic, also they may be saturated or unsaturated.

blocks.prompt:
5 Cycloalkanes are classified as:
(Cycloalkanes kis qisam mein aate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Alkanes acyclic (bina halqe ke) aliphatic hain jab ke cycloalkanes cyclic (halqa-daar) aliphatic hydrocarbons hain (11.1).

book_ref.quote: whereas cycloalkanes are cyclic aliphatic hydrocarbons

blocks.prompt:
6 Alkenes and alkynes are:
(Alkenes aur alkynes kis qisam ke hydrocarbons hain?)
blocks.explanation: Alkenes aur alkynes acyclic aur unsaturated (ghair-sair shuda) aliphatic hydrocarbons hain (11.1).

book_ref.quote: Alkenes and alkynes are acyclic and unsaturated aliphatic hydrocarbons.

blocks.prompt:
7 Aromatic hydrocarbons are cyclic hydrocarbons that:
(Aromatic hydrocarbons aise cyclic hydrocarbons hain jo:)

options.text: carbon ka hydrogen se ratio kam aur open chain
sirf single bonds aur open chain
carbon ka hydrogen se ratio ziyada aur benzene par mabni

blocks.explanation: Aromatic hydrocarbons cyclic hydrocarbons ki khaas qisam hain jin mein carbon ka hydrogen se tanasub (ratio) ziyada hota hai aur yeh benzene (C₆H₆) par mabni hote hain (11.1).

book_ref.quote: have high carbon to hydrogen ratio and are based on benzene

blocks.prompt:
8 Toluene and phenol are derivatives of:
(Toluene aur phenol kis compound ke derivatives (makhooz) hain?)
blocks.explanation: Benzene bunyaadi aromatic compound hai; toluene aur phenol is ke derivatives hain (11.1).

book_ref.quote: other compounds such as toluene and phenol are its derivatives

blocks.prompt:
9 The Greek word 'aroma', from which 'aromatic' comes, means:
(Greek lafz 'aroma', jis se 'aromatic' bana, ka matlab kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lafz aromatic Greek lafz 'aroma' se bana jis ka matlab khushbu-daar (fragrant) hai; in compounds ki khaas boo hoti hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: The term aromatic was derived from the Greek word

blocks.prompt:
10 The general formula of alkanes is:
(Alkanes ka general formula kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alkanes saturated hydrocarbons hain jin ka general formula CₙH₂ₙ₊₂ hai (11.2.1).

book_ref.quote: Alkanes are saturated hydrocarbons with the general formula CₙH₂ₙ₊₂.

blocks.prompt:
11 An alkane has 14 carbon atoms in its molecule. Its molecular formula is:
(Aik alkane ke molecule mein 14 carbon atoms hain. Is ka molecular formula kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: CₙH₂ₙ₊₂ mein n = 14: H = 2(14) + 2 = 30, is liye C₁₄H₃₀ (11.2.1).

book_ref.quote: Methane (CH₄) is the simplest member of this family.

blocks.prompt:
12 The correct molecular formula of heptane is:
(Heptane ka durust molecular formula kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: CₙH₂ₙ₊₂ mein n = 7 se heptane C₇H₁₆ hai (table ka chhapa hua C₇H₁₀ ghalat hai) (11.2.1).

book_ref.quote: By CₙH₂ₙ₊₂ heptane is C₇H₁₆

blocks.prompt:
13 Which alkane is used as a propellant in products such as shaving gel?
(Kaun sa alkane shaving gel jaisi cheezon mein propellant ke taur par istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Butane lighter ka fuel hai; isobutane shaving gel jaisi cheezon mein propellant (dhakelne wali gas) hai (11.2.1).

book_ref.quote: Isobutane is used as a propellant in products such as shaving gel.

blocks.prompt:
14 An alkyl group is named by:
(Alkyl group ka naam kaise rakha jata hai?)

options.text: alkane ke -ane ko -yl se badal kar

blocks.explanation: Alkane se aik hydrogen hata dene par alkyl group bachta hai; is ka naam -ane ko -yl se badal kar rakha jata hai (11.2.1).

book_ref.quote: The resulting alkyl groups are named by replacing –ane of the alkanes with –yl.

blocks.prompt:
15 The abbreviation Et– stands for the alkyl group:
(Abbreviation (mukhtasar alamat) Et– kis alkyl group ke liye hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 11.2: methyl CH₃– ka Me– aur ethyl CH₃–CH₂– ka Et– hai (11.2.1).

book_ref.quote: Table 11.2 alkyl groups, their names and abbreviations

blocks.prompt:
16 The IUPAC name of the isopropyl group CH₃CH(–)CH₃ is:
(Isopropyl group CH₃CH(–)CH₃ ka IUPAC naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 11.3 ke mutabiq isopropyl group CH₃CH(–)CH₃ ka IUPAC naam 1-methylethyl hai (11.2.1).

book_ref.quote: iso-Propyl group (1-Methylethyl)

blocks.prompt:
17 The correct IUPAC name of the tert-butyl group (CH₃)₃C– is:
(tert-butyl group (CH₃)₃C– ka durust IUPAC naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: (CH₃)₃C– mein jure hue carbon se lambi chain do carbon ki hai, is liye naam 1,1-dimethylethyl hai (Table 11.3 ki book correction) (11.2.1).

book_ref.quote: The IUPAC name of the tert-butyl group

blocks.prompt:
18 The group CH₃CH₂CH(–)CH₃ is called:
(Group CH₃CH₂CH(–)CH₃ ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Table 11.3: CH₃CH₂CH(–)CH₃ sec-butyl group hai, IUPAC naam 1-methylpropyl (11.2.1).

book_ref.quote: sec-Butyl group (1-Methylpropyl)

blocks.prompt:
19 The IUPAC name of the isobutyl group CH₃CH(CH₃)CH₂– is:
(Isobutyl group CH₃CH(CH₃)CH₂– ka IUPAC naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 11.3: isobutyl group CH₃CH(CH₃)CH₂– ka naam 2-methylpropyl hai (11.2.1).

book_ref.quote: Iso-Butyl group (2-Methylpropyl)

blocks.prompt:
20 How many different alkyl groups are listed for butane in Table 11.3?
(Table 11.3 mein butane se kitne mukhtalif alkyl groups diye gaye hain?)
blocks.explanation: Butane se: n-butyl, sec-butyl, isobutyl aur tert-butyl, yani chaar groups; do se ziyada carbon par aik se ziyada alkyl groups bante hain (11.2.1).

book_ref.quote: For alkanes with more than two carbon atoms, more than one alkyl groups can be derived.

blocks.prompt:
21 In naming a branched alkane, the parent name is decided by:
(Branched alkane ka naam rakhte waqt parent name kis se tay hota hai?)

options.text: carbon atoms ki sab se lambi musalsal chain

blocks.explanation: Rule 1: carbon atoms ki sab se lambi musalsal chain dhoondein; wohi parent name deti hai, chahe formula mein mudi hui ho (11.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Locate the longest continuous chain of carbon atoms; this chain determines the parent name for the alkane.

blocks.prompt:
22 The longest chain is numbered beginning from:
(Sab se lambi chain ki numbering kahan se shuru hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Rule 2: lambi chain ki numbering us sire se karein jo substituent ke qareeb ho (11.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Number the longest chain beginning from the end nearest to the substituent.

blocks.prompt:
23 The IUPAC name of CH₃–CH(CH₃)–CH₂–CH₂–CH₃ is:
(CH₃–CH(CH₃)–CH₂–CH₂–CH₃ ka IUPAC naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lambi chain 5 carbon (pentane); CH₃ ke qareeb sire se numbering karne par woh C-2 par hai: 2-methylpentane (11.2.2).

book_ref.quote: The parent name is placed last, and the substituent group, preceded by the number designating its location on the chain, is placed first.

blocks.prompt:
24 The IUPAC name of CH₃–CH(CH₃)–CH(CH₂CH₃)–CH₂–CH₃ is:
(CH₃–CH(CH₃)–CH(CH₂CH₃)–CH₂–CH₃ ka IUPAC naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lambi chain 5 carbon; methyl C-2 par, ethyl C-3 par; substituents alphabetical tarteeb (ethyl pehle, methyl baad) mein: 3-ethyl-2-methylpentane (11.2.2).

book_ref.quote: When two or more substituents are present, give each substituent a number corresponding to its location on the longest chain.

blocks.prompt:
25 While listing substituents in alphabetical order, which prefixes are ignored?
(Substituents ko alphabetical tarteeb mein likhte waqt kaun se prefixes nazar-andaz kiye jate hain?)

options.text: di aur tri jaise multiplying prefixes

blocks.explanation: Substituents alphabetical tarteeb mein (ethyl pehle methyl) likhe jate hain; di aur tri jaise multiplying prefixes nazar-andaz hote hain (11.2.2).

book_ref.quote: While deciding on alphabetical order ignored multiplying prefixes

blocks.prompt:
26 The IUPAC name of CH₃CH₂C(CH₃)₂CH₂CH₃ is:
(CH₃CH₂C(CH₃)₂CH₂CH₃ ka IUPAC naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: 5 carbon ki chain, C-3 par do CH₃; number do dafa likha jata hai aur di do aik jaise groups batata hai: 3,3-dimethylpentane (11.2.2).

book_ref.quote: When two substituents are present on the same carbon atom, use that number twice.

blocks.prompt:
27 Four identical substituents in a name are shown by the prefix:
(Naam mein chaar aik jaise substituents kis prefix se dikhaye jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aik jaise substituents di, tri, tetra waghera se dikhaye jate hain, maslan 2,2,3,3-tetramethylbutane (11.2.2).

book_ref.quote: When two or more substituents are identical, indicate this by the prefixes di, tri, tetra, and so on.

blocks.prompt:
28 When two chains of equal length compete for the parent chain, we choose the chain that has:
(Jab barabar lambai ki do chains parent chain banne ke liye muqable mein hon to kaun si chuni jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Rule 7: barabar chains mein se woh chunein jis par ziyada substituents hon (11.2.2).

book_ref.quote: When two chains of equal length compete for selection as the parent chain, choose the chain with the greater number of substituents.

blocks.prompt:
29 A hexane carries three methyl groups that can be numbered either 2,3,5 or 2,4,5. The correct name is:
(Aik hexane par teen methyl groups hain jin ki numbering 2,3,5 ya 2,4,5 ho sakti hai. Durust naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Rule 8: jab branching dono siron se barabar faasle par ho to pehle farq wali jagah par chhota number chunein: doosre number par 3, 4 se chhota hai, is liye 2,3,5 (11.2.2).

book_ref.quote: choose the name that gives the lower number at the first point of difference.

blocks.prompt:
30 A saturated ring of six carbon atoms is named:
(Chhe carbon atoms ke saturated ring ka naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cycloalkanes ka naam utne hi carbons wale alkane ke naam se pehle cyclo laga kar rakha jata hai: chhe carbon se cyclohexane (11.2.3).

book_ref.quote: Cycloalkanes are named by attaching the prefix

blocks.prompt:
31 The hybridization of each carbon atom in an alkane is:
(Alkane mein har carbon atom ki hybridization kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alkane ke har carbon ke chaar sp³ hybrid orbitals chaar single bonds banate hain; carbon ke gird shakal tetrahedral hai (11.2.3).

book_ref.quote: The carbon atom in an alkane has four sp³ hybridized orbitals

blocks.prompt:
32 The bond angle around a carbon atom in an alkane is:
(Alkane mein carbon atom ke gird bond angle kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Carbon ke gird chaar bonding pairs barabar dafa (repel) karte hain, is liye bond angle 109.5° hai (11.2.3).

book_ref.quote: repel each other to form 109.5° bond angles

blocks.prompt:
33 The C–C bond length in alkanes is:
(Alkanes mein C–C bond ki lambai kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alkanes mein carbon 109.5° angle aur 1.54 Å ki C–C bond length banate hain (11.2.3).

book_ref.quote: bond angles and a C-C bond length of 1.54 Å

blocks.prompt:
34 The shapes of organic molecules are generally represented by:
(Organic molecules ki shakal aam taur par kis tarah dikhai jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Organic molecules ki shakal aam taur par ball and stick formula se dikhai jati hai, jaise Table 11.4 mein (11.2.3).

book_ref.quote: The shapes of organic molecules are generally represented using ball and stick formula.

blocks.prompt:
35 The molecular formula of cyclopentane is:
(Cyclopentane ka molecular formula kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cycloalkanes CₙH₂ₙ hain; paanch ring carbons se cyclopentane C₅H₁₀ hai (Table 11.5 ki book correction) (11.2.3).

book_ref.quote: Cyclopentane has five ring carbons and cycloalkanes are CₙH₂ₙ

blocks.prompt:
36 Cycloalkanes are called saturated because:
(Cycloalkanes ko saturated kyun kaha jata hai?)

options.text: un ke ring mein double bond hai
ring ke saare carbon single bonds se jure hain

blocks.explanation: Cycloalkanes saturated hain: ring ke saare carbon doosre atoms se sirf single bonds se jure hain (11.2.3).

book_ref.quote: Cycloalkanes are also saturated, meaning that all of the carbons atoms that make up the ring are singly bonded to other atoms.

blocks.prompt:
37 At room temperature decane (C₁₀H₂₂) is a:
(Room temperature par decane (C₁₀H₂₂) kis haalat mein hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pentane se heptadecane (C₅ se C₁₇) be-rang, be-boo liquids hain; decane mein 10 carbon hain (11.2.4).

book_ref.quote: pentane to heptadecane (C₅ to C₁₇) are colourless, odourless liquids

blocks.prompt:
38 An alkane C₂₀H₄₂ is expected to be a:
(Alkane C₂₀H₄₂ kis haalat mein hoga?)
blocks.explanation: C₁₈ se aage ke alkanes be-rang, be-boo waxy (mom jaise) solids hain (11.2.4).

book_ref.quote: The higher members from C₁₈ onwards are waxy solids

blocks.prompt:
39 Alkanes are gases at room temperature when they contain:
(Room temperature par alkanes kab gas hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Chaar carbon atoms tak wale alkanes be-rang, be-boo gases hain (11.2.4).

book_ref.quote: Alkanes containing upto four carbon atoms are colourless, odourless, gases

blocks.prompt:
40 Alkanes dissolve in:
(Alkanes kis mein hal hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Alkanes non-polar hain: water jaise polar solvents mein hal nahi hote, hexane, benzene aur ether jaise non-polar solvents mein hal hote hain (11.2.4).

book_ref.quote: insoluble in polar solvents like water, but soluble in non-polar solvents

blocks.prompt:
41 Compared with butane (b.p. -0.50 °C), its branched isomer 2-methylpropane boils at:
(Butane (b.p. -0.50 °C) ke muqable mein is ka branched isomer 2-methylpropane kis temperature par ubalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Branched alkanes apne seedhi chain wale isomers se kam temperature par ubalte hain: butane -0.50 °C, 2-methylpropane -11.7 °C (11.2.4).

book_ref.quote: The boiling points of alkanes having branched chain structures are lower than their isomeric normal chain alkanes

blocks.prompt:
42 As the molecular mass of alkanes increases, their solubility:
(Alkanes ka molecular mass barhne se un ki solubility (hal-pazeeri) par kya asar hota hai?)

options.text: pehle barh kar la-mehdood ho jati hai

blocks.explanation: Carbon barhne se boiling point, melting point aur density barhte hain, jab ke solubility molecular mass barhne se kam hoti hai (11.2.4).

book_ref.quote: whereas solubility decreases with the increase in molecular mass

blocks.text: 11.3 Reaction mechanism and modes of bond breaking

blocks.prompt:
43 A reaction mechanism is:
(Reaction mechanism kya hai?)

options.text: poore reaction ke dauran hone wale qadmon ka silsila

blocks.explanation: Reaction mechanism woh qadmon ka silsila hai jo poore reaction ke dauran hote hain (11.3).

book_ref.quote: Reaction mechanism is the series of steps that take place in the course of the overall reaction.

blocks.prompt:
44 In how many ways can a covalent bond break?
(Covalent bond kitne tareeqon se toot sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Do tareeqe hain: homolytic fission aur heterolytic fission (11.3).

book_ref.quote: There are two ways in which covalent bonds can break.

blocks.prompt:
45 When a covalent bond breaks evenly, the products are:
(Jab covalent bond barabar toot-ta hai to kya bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Homolytic fission mein bond barabar toot-ta hai aur free radicals bante hain (11.3).

book_ref.quote: Homolytic fission occurs when the covalent bond breaks evenly to produce free radicals.

blocks.prompt:
46 A free radical is a species that contains:
(Free radical aisi species hai jis mein kya hota hai?)

options.text: poora octet aur koi charge nahi

blocks.explanation: Free radical mein aik unpaired (akela) electron hota hai aur woh bohat reactive hota hai (11.3).

book_ref.quote: Free Radical is a species that contains an unpaired electron and is very reactive.

blocks.prompt:
47 Free radicals are extremely reactive because:
(Free radicals bohat ziyada reactive kyun hote hain?)

options.text: un par negative charge hota hai
unpaired electrons jora banana chahte hain
un mein π bonds hote hain

blocks.explanation: Free radicals is liye bohat reactive hain ke unpaired electrons jora (pair) banana chahte hain (11.3).

book_ref.quote: Free radicals are extremely reactive because of the tendency of unpaired electrons to become paired.

blocks.prompt:
48 In heterolytic fission the shared pair of electrons:
(Heterolytic fission mein shared electron pair ka kya hota hai?)

options.text: sirf aik atom ko mil jata hai
dono atoms mein barabar bat jata hai

blocks.explanation: Heterolytic fission mein shared pair sirf aik atom le leta hai aur mukhalif charge wale ions bante hain (11.3).

book_ref.quote: the originally shared pair of electrons is gained by one atom only

blocks.prompt:
49 In mechanisms, heterolytic fission is shown by:
(Mechanisms mein heterolytic fission kis nishan se dikhaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mechanisms mein heterolytic fission poore curly arrows (mure hue teer) se dikhaya jata hai (11.3).

book_ref.quote: This bond fission is shown by full curly arrows in mechanisms.

blocks.prompt:
50 Heterolytic fission of the C–Cl bond in a chloroalkane gives:
(Chloroalkane mein C–Cl bond ke heterolytic fission se kya banta hai?)

options.text: a carbon radical and a chlorine radical
a carbocation and a chloride ion

blocks.explanation: Heterolytic fission se ions bante hain: carbocation aur chloride ion, radicals nahi (Figure 11.6) (11.3).

book_ref.quote: Heterolytic fission gives ions (a carbocation and a chloride ion), not radicals

blocks.text: 11.4 Unreactive nature of alkanes towards polar reagents

blocks.prompt:
51 The name paraffins for alkanes means:
(Alkanes ke naam paraffins ka matlab kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Paraffins Latin parum = thora aur affinis = affinity (lagao) se bana; alkanes aam haalat mein inert (be-amal) hain (11.4).

book_ref.quote: parum = little, affinis = affinity

blocks.prompt:
52 Under ordinary conditions alkanes are:
(Aam haalat mein alkanes kaise hote hain?)

options.text: acids, alkalis, oxidizing aur reducing agents ke saath inert
bromine water ko foran be-rang karte hain

blocks.explanation: Alkanes aam haalat mein acids, alkalis, oxidizing aur reducing agents ke saath inert (react nahi karte) hain (11.4).

book_ref.quote: are inert towards acids, alkalis, oxidizing and reducing agents under ordinary condition

blocks.prompt:
53 Using the electronegativity values given in the chapter, the difference between carbon and hydrogen is:
(Chapter mein di gayi electronegativity values se carbon aur hydrogen ka farq kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: 2.5 - 2.1 = 0.4; yeh chhota farq C–H bonds ko taqreeban non-polar banata hai (11.4).

book_ref.quote: The electronegativity values of carbon (2.5) and hydrogen (2.1) do not differ appreciably

blocks.prompt:
54 Alkanes do not react with polar reagents mainly because their bonds are:
(Alkanes polar reagents se is liye react nahi karte ke un ke bonds:)
blocks.explanation: C–H aur C–C mein bonding electrons taqreeban barabar share hote hain, is liye bonds non-polar aur aam taur par be-amal hain (11.4).

book_ref.quote: the bonding electrons between C–H and C–C are equally shared making them almost non-polar and generally unreactive

blocks.prompt:
55 A sigma bond is very stable because its electrons are:
(Sigma bond bohat mustahkam kyun hai?)

options.text: nuclei ke darmiyan mazbooti se pakre hue
plane ke upar neeche phaile hue

blocks.explanation: Sigma bond mein electrons nuclei ke darmiyan mazbooti se pakre hote hain; isse torne ke liye bohat energy chahiye (11.4).

book_ref.quote: In a sigma bond the electrons are very tightly held between the nuclei which makes it a very stable bond.

blocks.prompt:
56 Incomplete combustion of hydrocarbons can release:
(Hydrocarbons ke na-mukammal jalne (incomplete combustion) se kya nikal sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jalne se CO₂ (greenhouse gas) banti hai; na-mukammal jalne se carbon monoxide (CO) aur bareek zarraat nikal sakte hain (11.4).

book_ref.quote: Incomplete combustion can release carbon monoxide (CO) and particulate matter

blocks.prompt:
57 Combustion and cracking of alkanes are examples of:
(Alkanes ki combustion aur cracking kis qisam ke reactions hain?)
blocks.explanation: Ziyada temperature par alkanes thermal aur catalytic reactions (combustion, cracking) aur free radical substitution karte hain (11.5).

book_ref.quote: Thermal and Catalytic Reactions, e.g. Combustion and cracking

blocks.prompt:
58 Free radical substitution is the replacement of an atom or group of atoms by another through:
(Free radical substitution mein aik atom ya group doosre se kis tareeqe se badalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Free radical substitution mein aik atom ya group free radical mechanism ke zariye doosre se badalta hai (11.5).

book_ref.quote: replacement of one atom, or group of atoms by another through the free radical mechanism

blocks.prompt:
59 Alkanes react with chlorine and bromine in the presence of:
(Alkanes chlorine aur bromine se kis ki maujoodgi mein react karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Alkanes sunlight ya UV light mein chlorine aur bromine se react karte hain aur hydrogen atoms aik ke baad aik badalte hain (11.5.1).

book_ref.quote: Alkanes react with chlorine and bromine in the presence of sunlight or UV light

blocks.prompt:
60 The extent of halogenation of an alkane depends upon:
(Alkane ki halogenation kitni hogi, yeh kis par munhasir hai?)

options.text: istemal hone wali halogen ki miqdaar

blocks.explanation: Halogenation ki had istemal hone wali halogen ki miqdaar par munhasir hai (11.5.1).

book_ref.quote: The extent of halogenation depends upon the amount of halogen used.

blocks.prompt:
61 The reaction of alkanes with fluorine:
(Alkanes ka fluorine ke saath reaction kaisa hai?)

options.text: bohat shiddat wala; carbon, fluorinated alkanes aur hydrofluoric acid

blocks.explanation: Fluorine alkanes se bohat shiddat (violently) se react karti hai aur carbon, fluorinated alkanes aur hydrofluoric acid ka mixture deti hai (11.5.1).

book_ref.quote: Reaction of alkanes with fluorine is highly violent

blocks.prompt:
62 Iodine does not substitute alkanes directly because the reaction is:
(Iodine alkanes mein seedha substitution kyun nahi karti?)
blocks.explanation: Iodine seedha substitution nahi karti kyun ke reaction bohat aahista aur reversible hai (11.5.1).

book_ref.quote: Iodine does not substitute directly because the reaction is too slow and reversible.

blocks.prompt:
63 The order of reactivity of halogens towards alkanes is:
(Alkanes ke saath halogens ki reactivity ki tarteeb kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Halogens ki reactivity ki tarteeb F₂ > Cl₂ > Br₂ > I₂ hai (11.5.1).

book_ref.quote: The order of reactivity of halogens is:

blocks.prompt:
64 The initiation step of free radical chlorination involves:
(Free radical chlorination ke initiation step mein kya hota hai?)

options.text: UV light ki energy se Cl–Cl bond ka tootna

blocks.explanation: Initiation mein UV light ki energy se halogen-halogen bond toot-ta hai aur do chlorine free radicals bante hain (11.5.1).

book_ref.quote: It involves the breaking of the halogen-halogen bond using energy from the UV light.

blocks.prompt:

(Ethene water ki maujoodgi mein bromine se react kar ke kya banati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Halohydration: H₂C=CH₂ + Br₂ + H₂O → Br–CH₂–CH₂–OH + HBr; Br aur OH do alag carbons par (book correction) (11.8.1).

book_ref.quote: The product is 2-bromoethanol (ethylene bromohydrin)

blocks.prompt:
131 An epoxide is:
(Epoxide kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alkenes ki epoxidation se oxygen wala teen-rukni (three-membered) cyclic ether banta hai jise epoxide kehte hain (11.8.1).

book_ref.quote: oxygen-containing three-membered cyclic ether called epoxide

blocks.prompt:
132 Acid hydrolysis of an epoxide gives:
(Epoxide ki acid hydrolysis se kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Epoxides acid hydrolysis se diols ban jate hain (11.8.1).

book_ref.quote: The epoxides can be converted in to diols by acid hydrolysis.

blocks.prompt:
133 Ozonolysis of ethene finally gives:
(Ethene ki ozonolysis se aakhir mein kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ozone alkene ko oxidation se torti hai: C₂H₄ + O₃ → C₂H₄O₃ (ozonide) →(Zn/H₂O) 2CH₂O (11.8.1).

book_ref.quote: Ozonolysis is a method of oxidatively cleaving alkenes using ozone (O₃), a reactive allotrope of oxygen.

blocks.prompt:
134 Ozonolysis is often used to:
(Ozonolysis aksar kis kaam aati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ozonolysis na-maloom alkene ko chhote, asaani se pehchane jane wale tukron mein tor kar us ki banawat batati hai (11.8.1).

book_ref.quote: This reaction is often used to identify the structure of unknown alkenes

blocks.prompt:
135 In addition polymerization, monomers with at least one C=C form:
(Addition polymerization mein kam az kam aik C=C wale monomers kya banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Addition polymerization: kam az kam aik C=C wale bohat se monomers lambi polymer chains banate hain aur koi doosra product nahi (11.8.1).

book_ref.quote: form long chains of polymers as the only product

blocks.prompt:
136 The monomer of PVC is:
(PVC ka monomer kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: PVC chloroethene ka addition polymer hai; poly(ethene) ethene ka polymer hai (11.8.1).

book_ref.quote: Addition polymerisation of ethene and chloroethene

blocks.prompt:
137 The repeating unit of PVC is:
(PVC ka repeating unit kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Repeating unit monomer jaisa hi hai magar C=C, C–C single bond ban jata hai: CH₂=CHCl se –CH₂–CHCl– (11.8.1).

book_ref.quote: the repeating unit is the same as the monomer except that the C-C double bond is changed to a C-C single bond

blocks.prompt:
138 In the displayed formula of a polymer, the repeating unit is shown inside:
(Polymer ke displayed formula mein repeating unit kis mein dikhaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Repeating unit displayed aur general formula mein square brackets [ ] mein dikhaya jata hai (11.8.1).

book_ref.quote: It is represented by square brackets in the displayed and general formula.

blocks.prompt:
139 Polyethylene, made by polymerizing ethene, is used in:
(Ethene ki polymerization se bani polyethylene kis mein istemal hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ethene se polyethylene banti hai, aam plastic jo thailon, botalon aur packaging mein istemal hoti hai (11.8.1).

book_ref.quote: polymerized to make polyethylene

blocks.prompt:
140 Which of the following is a conjugated diene?
(In mein se conjugated diene kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Conjugated diene mein do double bonds ke darmiyan aik single bond hota hai, jaise CH₂=CH–CH=CH–CH₃ (11.9).

book_ref.quote: In a Conjugated diene, the double bonds in the carbon chain are separated by a single bond.

blocks.prompt:
141 In a conjugated diene, the adjacent double bonds allow:
(Conjugated diene mein saath saath double bonds kya mumkin banate hain?)

options.text: teen ya ziyada saath wale atoms par p-orbitals ki overlap

blocks.explanation: Saath ke double bonds teen ya ziyada saath wale atoms par p-orbitals ki overlap dete hain, aur electrons phail (delocalize) jate hain (11.9).

book_ref.quote: allow for the overlap of p-orbitals on three or more adjacent atoms

blocks.prompt:
142 1,3-Butadiene is used in the production of:
(1,3-Butadiene kis cheez ki tayyari mein istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: 1,3-butadiene jaise conjugated dienes synthetic rubber banane mein kaam aate hain; un ki polymer chains rubber jaisi hoti hain (11.9).

book_ref.quote: Conjugated dienes like 1,3-butadiene are used in the production of synthetic rubber.

blocks.prompt:
143 2-Methylbut-1,3-diene is commonly called:
(2-Methylbut-1,3-diene ka aam naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chapter mein CH₂=C(CH₃)–CH=CH₂, 2-methylbut-1,3-diene, ko isoprene kaha gaya hai, jo conjugated diene hai (11.9).

book_ref.quote: Conjugated dienes and delocalization of pi electrons

blocks.prompt:
144 Isomers are compounds having:
(Isomers kaise compounds hote hain?)

options.text: molecular formula aik, structural formula mukhtalif

blocks.explanation: Isomers ka molecular formula aik magar structural formula aur khasusiyat mukhtalif hoti hain (11.10).

book_ref.quote: Two or more compounds having the same molecular formula but different structural formulas and properties are said to be isomers

blocks.prompt:
145 The simplest hydrocarbon that has structural isomers is:
(Sab se saada hydrocarbon jis ke structural isomers hain, kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Structural isomers wala sab se saada hydrocarbon butane (C₄H₁₀) hai (11.10).

book_ref.quote: The simplest hydrocarbon to have structural isomers is butane (C₄H₁₀).

blocks.prompt:
146 The number of isomers of pentane (C₅H₁₂) is:
(Pentane (C₅H₁₂) ke kitne isomers hain?)
blocks.explanation: Paanch carbon wale pentane ke teen isomers hain (11.10).

book_ref.quote: The five carbon compound, pentane, has three isomers.

blocks.prompt:
147 1-Chlorobutane and 2-chlorobutane are isomers with the molecular formula:
(1-Chlorobutane aur 2-chlorobutane kis molecular formula ke isomers hain?)
blocks.explanation: Dono chlorobutanes ka formula C₄H₉Cl hai magar tarteeb aur physical khasusiyat mukhtalif hain (11.10).

book_ref.quote: chlorobutane molecule can have two different arrangements

blocks.prompt:
148 Structural isomerism, as described in the chapter, is exhibited in how many ways?
(Chapter ke mutabiq structural isomerism kitne tareeqon se zahir hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chain, position, functional group isomerism, metamerism aur tautomerism: paanch tareeqe (11.10.1).

book_ref.quote: The structural isomerism can be exhibited in five different ways.

blocks.prompt:
149 But-1-ene and but-2-ene are:
(But-1-ene aur but-2-ene kis qisam ke isomers hain?)
blocks.explanation: Dono mein sirf aik hi functional group (C=C) ki jagah mukhtalif hai: position isomerism (11.10.1).

book_ref.quote: difference in the position of the same functional group on the carbon chain

blocks.prompt:
150 Ethanol (C₂H₅OH) and methoxymethane (CH₃OCH₃) are:
(Ethanol (C₂H₅OH) aur methoxymethane (CH₃OCH₃) kis qisam ke isomers hain?)
blocks.explanation: Dono C₂H₆O hain magar functional groups mukhtalif (alcohol aur ether): functional group isomerism (11.10.1).

book_ref.quote: two compounds having the same molecular formula C₂H₆O

blocks.prompt:
151 Metamerism arises due to:
(Metamerism kis wajah se hota hai?)

options.text: functional group ke dono taraf carbon atoms ki na-barabar taqseem

blocks.explanation: Metamerism functional group ke dono taraf carbon atoms ki na-barabar taqseem se hota hai (11.10.1).

book_ref.quote: unequal distribution of carbon atoms on either side of the functional group

blocks.prompt:
152 Which pair are metamers?
(Kaun sa joda metamers hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ethoxyethane aur methoxypropane dono C₄H₁₀O ethers hain, O ke dono taraf carbons mukhtalif (book correction: diethyl ether aur methoxymethane ke formule mukhtalif hain) (11.10.1).

book_ref.quote: The printed example pair is ethoxy ethane (diethyl ether) and methoxy propane, both C₄H₁₀O.

blocks.prompt:
153 The two metamers of the ketone C₅H₁₀O are:
(Ketone C₅H₁₀O ke do metamers kaun se hain?)
blocks.explanation: Ketone C₅H₁₀O ke do metamers 2-pentanone aur 3-pentanone hain (11.10.1).

book_ref.quote: For a ketonic compound having the molecular formula C₅H₁₀O

blocks.prompt:
154 Metamers belong to:
(Metamers kis se taaluq rakhte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Metamers aik hi homologous series se hote hain, maslan dono ethers ya dono ketones (11.10.1).

book_ref.quote: Such compounds belong to the same homologous series.

blocks.prompt:
155 Tautomerism arises due to:
(Tautomerism kis wajah se hota hai?)

options.text: aik hi molecule mein proton ka aik atom se doosre par jana

blocks.explanation: Tautomerism aik hi molecule mein proton ke aik atom se doosre par jaane se hota hai, maslan amino acid se zwitterion (11.10.1).

book_ref.quote: This type of isomerism arises due to shifting of proton from one atom to another in the same molecule.

blocks.prompt:
156 Stereoisomers have the same structural formula but differ in:
(Stereoisomers ka structural formula aik hai magar woh kis cheez mein mukhtalif hain?)

options.text: aik jaise groups ki fazai jagah

blocks.explanation: Stereoisomers ka structural formula aik hai magar aik jaise groups ki fazai (space) jagah mukhtalif hai; qismein: geometrical (cis-trans) aur optical (11.10).

book_ref.quote: differ with respect to the positions of the identical groups in space

blocks.prompt:
157 During organic oxidation, normally:
(Organic oxidation mein aam taur par kya hota hai?)

options.text: hydrogen jurti hai ya oxygen nikalti hai
halogen hydrogen ki jagah leti hai
oxygen jurti hai ya hydrogen nikalti hai

blocks.explanation: Organic oxidation mein oxygen jurti ya hydrogen nikalti hai; reduction mein hydrogen jurti ya oxygen nikalti hai (11.11).

book_ref.quote: Normally, during organic oxidation, oxygen is added or hydrogen is removed.

blocks.prompt:
158 Organic redox reactions are characterized by:
(Organic redox reactions ki pehchan kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Organic redox reactions organic compounds ke hote hain aur un ki pehchan atoms/bonds ka jurna ya nikalna hai (11.11).

book_ref.quote: These reactions are characterized by the addition or removal of atoms/bonds.

blocks.prompt:
159 The conversion of ethene to ethane with H₂ over Pt is an example of:
(Pt par H₂ se ethene ka ethane banna kis ki misaal hai?)
blocks.explanation: C=C par hydrogen jor kar alkane banana organic reduction reaction hai (11.11).

book_ref.quote: Addition of hydrogen to carbon-carbon double bond to form alkane is an example of organic reduction reaction.

blocks.prompt:
160 Which of the following is a reducing agent named in the chapter for organic synthesis?
(Organic synthesis ke liye chapter mein diya gaya reducing agent kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Organic synthesis mein reducing agents: LiAlH₄, NaBH₄ aur Sn + conc. HCl (11.11).

book_ref.quote: Various reducing agents are used in Organic synthesis.

blocks.prompt:
161 Which conversion is an example of reduction?
(Kaun si tabdeeli reduction ki misaal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nitriles aur amides se amines, carboxylic acids se primary alcohols aur nitrobenzene se phenylamine reduction ki misalein hain (11.11).

book_ref.quote: carboxylic acid to primary alcohols, nitrobenzene to phenylamine

blocks.prompt:
162 In the complete combustion of ethane, the number of moles of O₂ needed per mole of ethane is:
(Ethane ke mukammal jalne mein aik mole ethane ke liye O₂ ke kitne moles chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: C₂H₆ + 7/2 O₂ → 2CO₂ + 3H₂O: daayen taraf O atoms = 2(2) + 3 = 7, is liye 7/2 = 3.5 mol O₂ (book correction) (11.11.1).

book_ref.quote: The balanced equation is C₂H₆ + 7/2 O₂ → 2CO₂ + 3H₂O

blocks.prompt:
163 Oxidation of ethanol with acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ gives:
(Acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ se ethanol ki oxidation se kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Primary alcohols acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ se carboxylic acids bante hain: C₂H₅OH + 2[O] → CH₃COOH + H₂O (11.11.1).

book_ref.quote: Reaction of primary alcohols with acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ to make carboxylic acids

blocks.prompt:
164 The epoxidation of an alkene is an example of:
(Alkene ki epoxidation kis qisam ka reaction hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alkene ki epoxidation, molecular oxygen aur metal catalysts jaise oxidizing agents se, oxidation reaction hai (11.11.1).

book_ref.quote: The epoxidation of alkene is also example of oxidation reaction.
